Under POL-COLL-004 §4.2 (v4.2, current), reduced hours count as financial hardship. Before asking for any payment, the agent must acknowledge the hardship, record hardship_flag with the stated reason, and offer at least one eligible hardship option. Examples are the 3-month reduced payment (HP-LOAN-RED3: 50% of the regular payment for 3 months), the reduced card minimum (HP-CARD-MIN), the reduced rate (HP-CARD-RATE) or a skip-a-payment. The agent must not ask for a payment the customer has said they cannot afford. Programmes of 3 months or less don't need income evidence (§4.3). This is a critical QA item (qa_checklist item 7).
